hero.name: Amin Khoddam
hero.intro: Frontend Developer with 2+ years building production React/Next.js applications in TypeScript. Sole frontend engineer of a bilingual (EN/FA, RTL) B2B marketplace with 130 pages, role-based access, real-time chat, and a streaming AI interface. Owns frontend architecture end to end, from rendering strategy to API layer.

about.title: Frontend engineering with a product mindset
about.lead: I turn product requirements into interfaces that are fast, accessible and maintainable — and I document the decisions behind them.

paragraphs.p1: I have over two years of experience building production-ready web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. As the sole frontend developer of a bilingual B2B marketplace, I architected and developed a 130-page application covering admin, supplier, customer, and public interfaces, with role-based access control.
paragraphs.p2: My work goes beyond building UI components. I take ownership of frontend architecture end to end, from rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, and ISR) and API integration to state management, caching, and performance optimization. I have also built real-time communication features using WebSockets and AI-powered product discovery interfaces with streamed responses using the Vercel AI SDK.
paragraphs.p3: I have hands-on experience building bilingual applications with Persian and English support, treating RTL and localization as core parts of the development process. I focus on creating maintainable, scalable frontend architectures, reusable UI components, and responsive interfaces that deliver a consistent experience across different user roles and devices.

experience.title: Two years
experience.description: Where I have worked and what I actually shipped there.

parsAzma.summary: Personal care and cosmetics company; five-person product team (backend, UI/UX, QA, tech lead, frontend).

highlights.h1: Architected and built a bilingual (EN/FA, RTL) B2B marketplace in Next.js (App Router) as the sole frontend developer: 130 pages across admin, supplier, customer and public areas, with role-based access control.
highlights.h2: Implemented a 17-page tender workflow across customer, supplier and admin views: requests receive supplier offers and close on acceptance or deadline expiry.
highlights.h3: Built an AI product-discovery chat in React (Vite) with streamed responses via the Vercel AI SDK; managed server state with React Query, UI state with Zustand, and response cancellation with AbortController.
highlights.h4: Developed a real-time ticketing chat (WebSocket) with reconnection, file upload/download and notifications.
highlights.h5: Applied dynamic imports and per-page SSR/SSG/ISR rendering, and tuned React Query caching to avoid redundant requests; used Lighthouse and DevTools to diagnose bottlenecks.
highlights.h6: Built a centralized Axios layer with role-based auth and unified error handling, redirecting invalid sessions to login.

parsAzmaIntern.summary: Worked on multiple projects with full frontend ownership.

highlights.h1: Built a task manager in Next.js with Redux Toolkit and Material UI, featuring a calendar timeline, personal and group tasks, and WebSocket notifications.
highlights.h2: Extended the existing storefront with product filtering and a variant-driven product detail page (price and details by color, size and seller); debugged and optimized teammates’ code.
